🎥🩸: Simon Says (2026)

A lavish birthday party turns into a living nightmare when an unsettling entertainer hijacks the celebration with a deadly game of “Simon Says.” The rules are simple—follow every command exactly or face horrifying consequences that leave the remaining guests terrified.

With every round, the challenges become more vicious, forcing the survivors to outthink the game’s sadistic mastermind while fear and suspicion tear the group apart. As the body count climbs, they realize escaping the party may be impossible unless someone finds a way to break the rules.

Equal parts slasher, comedy, and suspense, Simon Says delivers inventive scares, shocking twists, and nonstop tension, proving that even the most innocent childhood game can become a fight to the death.

Simon Says is out now on Tubi.
